```python
def choose_num(x: int, y: int) -> int:
    """Returns the biggest even integer in the range [x, y] inclusive, or -1 if none exists."""
    if x > y:
        return -1

    start = x if x % 2 == 0 else x + 1
    end = y if y % 2 == 0 else y - 1

    return end if end >= start else -1
```
